picks.headline: Adobe Expands Its AI Integrations to Gemini, Plus Further Powers Up With Claude
picks.excerpt: Adobe has announced more AI integration news with its new Adobe in Gemini plugin, along with upgrades to its Adobe in Claude plugin.
picks.rationale: A new Adobe in Gemini plugin and an upgraded Claude plugin let creators run Adobe tools from inside chat assistants. This is a new release that changes how assets get made and edited.

picks.headline: Digital Anarchy releases Beauty Box update
picks.excerpt: The new Beauty Box v6.5, now released, adds a new filter for eye and teeth whitening that uses machine learning to identify those areas. The newest version of Digital Anarchy's real-time skin retouching tool for video adds teeth and eye whitening and a new, faster GPU inference engine, that runs loc
picks.rationale: Beauty Box 6.5 adds ML-detected eye and teeth whitening and a faster local GPU inference engine. Editors and colorists can use it in their retouching passes right away.

picks.headline: Jeffrey Katzenberg Says Hollywood Must Accept AI as a Tool: It 'Is Not Going Away'
picks.excerpt: Jeffrey Katzenberg, the legendary Hollywood producer, thinks Hollywood needs to accept AI if it wants to remain at the forefront of the future.
picks.rationale: A top animation and studio producer describes AI as a production tool the industry has to adopt. It shows where studio leadership is steering production pipelines.

picks.headline: Canada Debates AI's Place In Animation At OIAF's TAC
picks.excerpt: A panel of local industry vets tackled AI's effect on entry-level jobs, creative control, and the growing problems with large AI models.
picks.rationale: Animation veterans at Ottawa's TAC break down how AI is affecting entry-level jobs and creative control. It is a view of AI in animation pipelines from the studio floor.

picks.headline: Lawyers Discuss Artificial Intelligence's Risks & Rewards For Hollywood
picks.excerpt: AI on the docket: Lawyers panel discusses the risks and rewards of artificial intelligence for Hollywood during a panel at Deadline's inaugural L.A. Law Summit.
picks.rationale: Entertainment lawyers set out the legal risks of using AI in productions and the upside. This matters to any production deciding which AI tools it can safely use.
